title: dynamicVariantRecalculationRequest
description: Request body for triggering dynamic variant recalculation. Accepts up to 1000 product IDs at any level of the hierarchy — the system resolves the root for each ID automatically. Intended to be called after a batch of products has been fully ingested, not per individual product write.

productIds.description: List of product IDs (variants at any hierarchy level) for which recalculation should be triggered. The system groups IDs by their root product and creates one job per unique root.
